born: c. 347, Antioch (background; not verified in sources I read)
died: 407, in exile (Comana, Pontus) (background; not verified in sources I read)
role/place: Presbyter in Antioch, then archbishop of Constantinople (398–404); the most prolific Greek preacher of the period, whose homilies on Hebrews, Matthew, Titus and the Adversus Judaeos survive.
why_relevant: He wrote the homilies on Hebrews that comment on Heb 10:26–31 (the verse TikTok cites) and the homilies on Matthew that discuss how Jesus treats the Law and heretics, so he answers both the Hebrews and the Gospel side of the question.
